sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3. Languoid page lach1251 'Lachirioag Zapotec' (bookkeeping) and yate1242 'Yatee Zapotec'.
sources.note: lach1251 carries no descriptive references at all; yate1242 lists only Jaeger & Van Valin 1982 (phonology article) and Van Valin 1998 (syntax chapter).
